items.description: Non-banking financial companies have begun reassessing gold loan structures following increased delinquencies in recent months. Bajaj Finance and Manappuram Finance are shifting towards longer-tenure loans in response to customer difficulties. Many borrowers are struggling to adapt to new repayment schedules that require more frequent payments. Muthoot Finance has also reported a significant rise in overdue loans tied to repayment structure changes.

items.author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
items.description: In 2018, Kapil Kumar launched the Clean Up Ram Ganga Campaign to tackle the escalating pollution crisis of the river. Over 5,000 volunteers have joined forces for more than 218 clean-up drives, focusing not just on removing trash but also fostering responsible waste management practices. With efforts aimed at composting organic waste and addressing untreated sewage, Kumar advocates for a lasting change in community behavior towards the river's health.

items.title: Scans suggest Rob Roy's gravestone has carvings 1,000 years older than him
items.author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
items.description: A recent study has uncovered that the gravestone of Rob Roy MacGregor, found at Balquhidder Parish Church, has roots that stretch back an astonishing thousand years prior to his life. Utilizing 3D imaging techniques, researchers have discovered that the stone features carvings from multiple eras, hinting at a potential connection to early medieval Christianity through its intricate designs. For those intrigued, digital models have been made publicly accessible for exploration.

items.title: Barbara Hepworth sculpture given to doctor may fetch £80,000 at auction
items.author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
items.description: Barbara Hepworth's miniature sculpture of Winged Figure, a personal gift to Dr. Roger Slack, is returning to auction. Roger Slack's relationship with Hepworth grew out of their doctor-patient dynamic within the arts community in St Ives. The sculpture reflects Hepworth's artistic legacy and her significant public work on Oxford Street.
